component.name: CheckboxGroup
component.description: Group of related checkboxes with optional master checkbox for select-all functionality.

parts.label: group label
parts.description: Label for the entire checkbox group.

parts.label: master checkbox
parts.description: Optional select-all/none checkbox with indeterminate state.

layout.direction: vertical stack (group label → master checkbox → options)
constraints: Options stack vertically with consistent spacing.

behavior.map: Groups related checkboxes under a common label. Optional master checkbox controls all child checkboxes: when clicked, selects or deselects all. Master checkbox shows indeterminate state when some (but not all) children are selected. Supports initial selection via defaultSelected prop. Calls onChange with array of selected option values.
behavior.rendering: Always renders group label. Master checkbox renders if showMasterCheckbox=true. Individual option checkboxes render from options array.
behavior.defaultState: All unchecked unless defaultSelected provides initial values.

logic.effect: Selects all option checkboxes. Calls onChange with all option values.
Deselects all option checkboxes. Calls onChange with empty array.
Updates checkedStates array. Calls onChange with array of selected values. Updates master checkbox state (checked/indeterminate/unchecked).

content: Options array must have unique values.
Each option must have label and value properties.
Master label defaults to i18n 'All' if not provided.
nesting: Contains Checkbox components (cannot nest CheckboxGroup inside itself).
Should be nested in forms or fieldsets.

aria.groupLabel: Associated via htmlFor attribute to master checkbox or group container.
aria.optionCheckboxes: Each has unique ID for label association.

accessibility.keyboard: Space toggles checkboxes. Tab/Shift+Tab navigates between checkboxes.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus ring on each checkbox (inherited from Checkbox component).
accessibility.contrast: All text meets WCAG AA (4.5:1 minimum).

responsiveness.rules: Checkboxes stack vertically on all screen sizes. Labels wrap if constrained.

then.render: master checkbox with indeterminate state support

usageNotes: Provide unique, stable option values for consistent state management.
Use defaultSelected for initial selection (uncontrolled component).
onChange receives array of selected option values.
Master checkbox automatically calculates checked/indeterminate state based on child checkboxes.
Master label defaults to i18n 'All' but can be customized via masterLabel prop.
Options array changes reset state (unless only labels change).
Component uses useEffect to avoid resetting state when only labels change (checks option values).
Group label is required for accessibility.
